pending_interview.category: Case/product sense — client scoping walkthroughs, articulating tradeoffs out loud, build-vs-buy reasoning
pending_interview.question: "A mid-market e-commerce company comes to you. They have about 2 million customers and a reasonable data engineering team, but no dedicated ML (machine learning) platform. They want a product recommendation engine — the kind that shows 'customers like you also bought X.' Their CTO says they want it live in 90 days and is leaning toward building it in-house because they feel it will be 'more customizable.' Walk me through how you would scope this engagement, what questions you would ask in the first meeting, and what recommendation you would make on build versus buy — and why."
